doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Lectures on the psychology of improvisation
summary: He gives presentations called Unlocking the Creative Impulse, with keyboard examples.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: And we’ll hopefully be doing some concerts around that. And then in the early spring, like maybe February or March, we’re going to do a midwest tour and that should include a week at the Jazz Showcase in Chicago. Then I’ll be going back to the Jazz Standard in May and doing some other East Coast things. Then in the summer hopefully some stuff in Europe. So that’s the touring with the trio. I also do duets with David Grisman, the mandolin player. We did an album for his label, Acoustic Disk, that came out about a year ago. And he’s wonderfully refreshing to play with. And so we do duet concerts periodically, you kind of get salted in among his quintet dates. And I look forward to that. And then I do a certain amount of solo concerts every year which is a special treat for me. I mean I love playing with people but there’s also a special challenge and delight in being the whole orchestra, which a piano can do under the best of circumstances. So I look forward to that. And then I usually do a couple of presentations each year which I call Unlocking the Creative Impulse: The Psychology of Improvisation, where I talk about some of the issues we’ve talked about today, some of the psychological obstacles and what the nature of that merger experience is when you get into the music. What are some of the rituals and preparations one can get involved in that help usher in that state. And then I give examples at the keyboard and take questions from the audience. It’s really a lot of fun. I do this sometimes for music schools or psychology departments, and sometimes for just lay audiences of certain groups who are interested in the creative process.
